book.p: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.The earth was formless and empty.footnote text must be ignored Darkness was on the surface of the deep.God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
The heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished.
Deuterocanonical verse that must be skipped.

p.wj: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
He who believes in him is not judged.

book.p: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John
As they went on the way, they came to some water.TR adds verse 37.He commanded the chariot to stand still.
Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James.Mercy to you and peace and love be multiplied.Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you.
